name: Topology certification or classification
references: Uptime Institute Tier Standard: Topology; ANSI/TIA-942; EN 50600 series / ISO/IEC 22237 series
edition_profile: TO BE FIXED by the practitioner reviewer before approval: edition and assessment profile
scope: Design topology and, where certified, constructed facility of power, cooling and supporting infrastructure against a redundancy or availability class
evidence: Design documents, single-line and mechanical diagrams; site inspection for constructed-facility certification
constraints: Point-in-time; design and construction documents only; no operational records
exclusions: EXC-01: Operational practices, staffing and maintenance (unless an operations certification is in scope); EXC-02: IT equipment, networks and software above the facility interface
applicability: APP-01: Applies to factors in facility power, cooling, physical and site infrastructure

name: Commissioning and integrated systems testing
references: ASHRAE Guideline 0 (The Commissioning Process); ASHRAE Guideline 1.1 (HVAC&R technical requirements); Level 1 to 5 commissioning practice including integrated systems testing (IST)
edition_profile: TO BE FIXED by the practitioner reviewer before approval: edition and assessment profile
scope: Verification that facility systems are installed and perform to the owner's project requirements, at handover and at recommissioning
deliverable: Commissioning plan, test scripts and results, issues log, commissioning report
evidence: Owner's project requirements, basis of design, functional and integrated test results, witnessed tests
constraints: At handover or a defined recommissioning event; tests use the load and scenarios in the approved test scripts
exclusions: EXC-01: Conditions arising after the last commissioning or recommissioning event; EXC-02: IT systems, fabrics and workloads above the facility interface
applicability: APP-01: Applies to factors in installed facility systems and their controls

name: Engineering and reliability studies
references: Power system studies (IEEE 3000 series: short circuit, coordination, arc flash, load flow, transient stability); FMEA / FMECA (IEC 60812); fault tree analysis (IEC 61025); cooling, thermal and CFD studies
edition_profile: TO BE FIXED by the practitioner reviewer before approval: edition and assessment profile
scope: Analysis of the design or as-built facility power and cooling systems for faults, failure modes, coordination and capacity
deliverable: Study reports with assumptions, models and recommendations
evidence: Single-line diagrams, equipment data, protection settings, load data, mechanical schematics, failure-rate data
constraints: Scoped by engagement; based on design or as-built data supplied; recorded study assumptions
exclusions: EXC-01: Systems not named in the study scope; EXC-02: Organisational, operational and security factors
applicability: APP-01: Applies to factors in facility power and cooling engineering (record eng_discipline POWER, COOLING or OTHER)

name: OT security risk assessment
references: IEC 62443-3-2 (security risk assessment for system design); IEC 62443-3-3 (system security requirements and security levels)
edition_profile: TO BE FIXED by the practitioner reviewer before approval: edition and assessment profile
scope: Security risk assessment of industrial automation and control systems (BMS, EPMS, CDU and PLC/SCADA), zones and conduits
deliverable: Risk assessment, zone and conduit model, target and achieved security levels, gap list
evidence: Asset inventory, network architecture, zone and conduit drawings, access and remote-access arrangements, configuration samples
constraints: Scoped by system under consideration; documentation review, interviews and sampled configuration
exclusions: EXC-01: Systems outside the defined system under consideration; EXC-02: Non-security failures of the physical process
applicability: APP-01: Applies where the factor involves automation or control systems or their networks

name: Information security management audit
references: ISO/IEC 27001 with ISO/IEC 27002 controls; AICPA SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria)
edition_profile: TO BE FIXED by the practitioner reviewer before approval: edition and assessment profile
scope: The organisation's information security management system or the service organisation's controls within the declared scope
deliverable: Certification audit report or SOC 2 report
evidence: Policies, risk treatment, statement of applicability, sampled control evidence
constraints: Sampled; scope set by the organisation's declared ISMS or system description
exclusions: EXC-01: Facility engineering performance outside the declared scope; EXC-02: Systems not in the statement of applicability or system description
applicability: APP-01: Applies to factors in information security, access, change and supplier management within the declared scope

name: Technical due diligence
references: Practice-based; no single standard. Scope from a declared reference engagement letter
edition_profile: TO BE FIXED by the practitioner reviewer before approval: edition and assessment profile
scope: Expert review of a facility's design, condition, operations and risks for a transaction or lease
constraints: Short duration; limited access; reliance on information provided
exclusions: EXC-01: Anything excluded in the reference engagement letter
applicability: APP-01: Applies to factors within the reference engagement letter scope

name: AIDCF assessment (realistic constraints for estimated operational detectability)
references: AIDCF-009 Assessment Methodology; AIDCF-007A control catalogue; registries/controls/evidence-profiles.csv
scope: The in-scope Capability Instance and its dependencies
deliverable: Assessment record, gate results and decision
evidence: Evidence classes required by each control's evidence profile
constraints: Sampling and duration as set in the AIDCF-009 assessment plan for the Capability Instance
